title: Swift: SkinWebGridView.focusedIndex becomes focusedID
description: Grid's own WKWebView wrapper switches its focus contract from a positional Int index to the real game id, matching the JS-side change in a separate piece. Grid always renders its full unfiltered list, so this was previously correct 'by luck' - now correct by construction.
commit_message: Change SkinWebGridView's focus contract from index to id
